bedouin soundclash.bio: Canadian band Bedouin Soundclash blends reggae, punk, indie rock and world-music influences in a catalogue that includes the breakout single When the Night Feels My Song.

caribou.bio: Caribou is the recording project of Dundas, Ontario-born Canadian musician and producer Dan Snaith, whose work moves between psychedelic pop, electronic music and house.

crash test dummies.bio: Winnipeg-formed Canadian rock band Crash Test Dummies combines alternative rock and folk influences with Brad Roberts' distinctive baritone vocals.

deadmau5.bio: Niagara Falls-born Canadian producer and DJ deadmau5, born Joel Zimmerman, is a major electronic-music figure known for progressive house, electro house and his mau5trap label.

dream warriors.bio: Toronto hip-hop group Dream Warriors is a pioneering Canadian jazz-rap act known for inventive sampling, playful lyricism and the landmark album And Now the Legacy Begins.

dubmatique.bio: Montréal group Dubmatique is a foundational francophone Canadian hip-hop act whose platinum-selling work helped establish French-language rap in Québec's mainstream music scene.

d-sisive.bio: Toronto rapper D-Sisive is a veteran of Canadian underground hip-hop known for autobiographical writing, dark humour and an independent catalogue stretching back to the late 1990s.

dj shub.bio: Mohawk producer and turntablist Shub, formerly known as DJ Shub, helped pioneer powwow-step as a member of A Tribe Called Red before building an award-winning solo career in Indigenous electronic music.

glenn lewis.bio: Kitchener-born, Toronto-raised singer-songwriter Glenn Lewis is a Juno-winning Canadian neo-soul and R&B vocalist known for the hit Don't You Forget It.

good kid.bio: Toronto indie-rock band Good Kid makes fast, guitar-driven songs with a large online following built through gaming, streaming communities and energetic live shows.

half moon run.bio: Montréal-based Canadian band Half Moon Run blends indie rock, folk, art rock and layered vocal harmonies in a catalogue rooted in the city's collaborative music scene.

high klassified.bio: Laval producer High Klassified, born Kevin Vincent, is a Québec hip-hop and electronic producer known for atmospheric instrumentals and major rap and R&B collaborations.

jann arden.bio: Calgary singer-songwriter Jann Arden is a multi-platinum Canadian pop artist, actor and author whose long-running career includes multiple Juno Awards and induction into the Canadian Music Hall of Fame.

k'naan.bio: Somali-Canadian rapper, singer-songwriter and filmmaker K'naan built his career in Toronto, blending hip-hop with Somali musical influences and gaining international recognition with Wavin' Flag.

k.d. lang.bio: Edmonton-born Canadian singer-songwriter k.d. lang is an acclaimed country, pop and folk vocalist whose career includes multiple Juno and Grammy Awards and induction into the Canadian Music Hall of Fame.

kiesza.bio: Calgary-born Canadian singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Kiesza makes house-influenced pop and electronic music and broke internationally with the 2014 single Hideaway.

lennon stella.bio: Oshawa-born Canadian singer and actor Lennon Stella moved from the sibling duo Lennon & Maisy and the television series Nashville into a solo pop and alternative-R&B career.
